name: Marma Gulika (Vati)

sections.introduction: Marma Gulika (Vati) is very effective ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of herbs. Marmas are known as special pressure points present in the body, so this formulation is efficient to treat the problems related to marma places.
sections.ingredients:
Rakta chandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Sahasravedhi – Rumex vesicarius 
 Shatavari – Asparagus racemosus root 
 Vidari – Pueraria tuberosa 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Jivanti – Leptadenia reticulata 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Varahi – Tacca aspera 
 Tavaksheeri – Curcuma angustifolia 
 Kurunivikizingu 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis Gaertn. 
 Durva – Cynodon dactylon 
 Yashti – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Kumari – Aloe vera 
 Chandana – Santalum album 
 Hrivera – Pavonia odorata 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Shuddha Shilajatu – Asphaltum 
 Palunirvasi 
 Garudapacha 
 Prasarini – Paederia foetida 
 Kozappu – Lonika 
 Plaksha – Ficus lacor 
 Pullani – calycopteris floribunda 
 Katabhi – Celastrus paniculatus 
 Lodhra – Symplocos racemosa 
 Nyagrodha – Ficus bengalensis 
 Udumbara – Ficus racemosa 
 Ashwattha – Ficus religiosa 
 Nara – Eugenia jambolana 
 Karamarda – Carissa congesta 
 Darvi – Berberis aristata 
 Pashanabheda – Aerva lanata 
 Mudga – Averrhoa carambola 
 Masha – Vigna radiata 
 Ela – Elettaria cardamomum 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take ingredients number 1 to 23 up to 192 grams. 
 Powder all these herbs. 
 Make the water decoction of these herbs by boiling mixture of powder in 9.2 liters and boil till this is reduced up to 2.304 liters volume. 
 Filter this decoction. 
 Now, take the ingredients from 24 to 33 up to 96 grams and pashanabheda up to 384 grams. 
 Powder the ingredients, make its water decoction and then filter it. 
 At last take ingredients from number 35 to 37 up to 768 grams. 
 Powder the ingredients, make its decoction and filter in the last. 
 Now mix all the decoction products and make its paste. 
 Now make the tablets from this paste. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Marma Gulika (Vati) is an effectual Ayurvedic formulation that helps to keep the Vata, Pitta and kapha balanced. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is very helpful in to provide healing effect in disease linked to heart, brain, urinary system, liver etc. It is even useful in external injuries to vital organs. 
 It possesses anti-inflammatory property, which helps to lessen edema, eliminating the excessive fluid out of the body, thereby reducing swelling and provides relief from its discomfort. It also provides relief from rheumatic pain. It is able to heal wounds, bruises and fall injuries, imparting relief from swelling, redness and pain on wounds and boils. It is helpful in drainage of abscess too. It even provides benefits in urinary conditions, as in gonorrhea, reduces the excessive discharge, reduces burning sensation, and provides soothing effect to patient. It imparts relief from painful micturition, supports easy passing of urine. 
 Provides beneficial results in nervous disorders, effective in syncope and helpful in giddiness as well as faintness. It reduces headache effectively.
sections.indications:
Pain in body 
 White discharge 
 Heart diseases 
 Liver diseases 
 Urinary tract infections 
 Nervous disorders
sections.dose:
Two tablets, one or two times a day, before or after meals. 
 Apply on injuries as its external use. 
 During leucorrhea and micturition consume in coconut water.
sections.contraindications:
Take under medical prescription 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
